function.name: search_slots
function.description: Find actual available windows after confirmed eligible address and known HVAC job, for routine or priority calls. Priority calls get the earliest regular window (there is no on-call or overnight service) and the dispatcher is alerted automatically. Each slot has spoken, a ready-to-say window relative to today in New York (e.g. "tomorrow, Tuesday, November twenty-fourth, between one and four"): say it as given. Availability accounts for technician skills, shifts and overlapping assignments. When windows are found, the earliest is already held as an offer (offer: proposal_id, spoken): offer that one and use its proposal_id with confirm_booking; call propose_booking only for a different window. Does not book a technician; never invent slots. Any result that isn't a success has status, missing, expected (exact saved values to echo) and a one-sentence hint: follow the hint and never speak past it as if it worked. stop_retrying means stop calling this tool: record request_followup(reason=technical_issue) and tell the caller the team will follow up.
